kafka_cluster.description: The name of the Kafka cluster this Kafka Connect cluster is attached to. Structured like: `projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOCATION/clusters/CLUSTER_ID`.
kafka_cluster.rationale: Used for attachment reference; does not directly impact access or data protection.

capacity_config.description: A capacity configuration of a Kafka cluster.
capacity_config.rationale: Capacity impacts availability but not directly related to security posture.

vcpu_count.description: The number of vCPUs to provision for the cluster. The minimum is 3.
vcpu_count.rationale: Affects performance but not confidentiality or integrity.

memory_bytes.description: The memory to provision for the cluster. CPU:Memory ratio must be between 1:1 and 1:8.

gcp_config.description: Configuration properties for a Kafka Connect cluster deployed to GCP.
gcp_config.rationale: This includes networking config which affects visibility, access, and isolation.
non-compliant: Open access or public IP exposure

access_config.description: Access configuration for the Kafka Connect cluster.
access_config.rationale: Controls how the Connect cluster is accessed. Improper setup risks exposure.

location.description: ID of the location of the Kafka Connect resource.
location.rationale: Does not influence access or encryption directly.

connect_cluster_id.description: The ID used for the Connect Cluster.

labels.rationale: Used for metadata. Does not alter security posture.

project.description: Provider project used if not explicitly set.
project.rationale: Does not directly affect resource access or encryption.

access_config.rationale: Manages network exposure of the cluster.

network_configs.description: VPC subnets used for Kafka Connect cluster.
network_configs.rationale: Defines network isolation. Insecure subnet increases exposure.
Defines networking for PSC interfaces, which affect secure access.
compliant: Primary and additional subnets from approved VPC

primary_subnet.description: Primary VPC subnet used for PSC interface.
primary_subnet.rationale: Defines where traffic is routed from/to. Impacts exposure level.
compliant: Private RFC1918 subnet with /22 or larger

additional_subnets.description: Secondary subnets from same VPC network.
additional_subnets.rationale: May open routing paths across regions or networks. Needs validation.
compliant: Additional secure subnets from same VPC

dns_domain_names.description: Domain names made visible to the Connect cluster.
dns_domain_names.rationale: Exposing internal domains could leak topology or allow SSRF.
compliant: Limit to known Kafka bootstrap DNS
non-compliant: Generic internal DNS or all wildcard domains
